author: MtnL
body:
IGN:MtnL
Discord( Name#):MtnL#0525
Timezone:Eastern Time Zone
Any previous Ref experience? No I do not but I am currently on the Social Media team 
Why would you like to join the referee team: I would like to join the avicus referee team because I genuinely enjoy playing avicus and I want to try and make it possible for more tournaments and I feel if we have more available referees we can have more games and we can grow out the server in whole.
Are you able to commit to Saturday Tournaments, and occasionally event staff meetings? I am able to commit to Saturday Tournaments, and I should be able to go to every staff meetings
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself: I am a positive , active , mature ,all around fun to talk to guy. I enjoy having a good time with people and just talking with people who share interests with me. I love a good competition and I am very competitive myself. I am usually always trying my best to improve something, whether it be Myself or the community or it can go as small to just giving an idea of a cool idea that could help the server!
Anything else?: Last but not least, like I said before I do have experience on the Social Media team and I would like to say thanks so much for taking your time to read this and I hope you have a great day!
